title: Decide and enforce which sorties a peer base may inspect
goal: A peer base reads only the sorties the owner chose to share over the Kaji line
acceptance: The owner picks one option from the full audit of 2026-11-13 (all sorties; only sorties the asking base took part in; those, minus local-only or tainted ones)
The peer-side handler enforces the choice using the authenticated asking base
A cross-base regression covers an allowed and a refused sortie
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: Cross-base regression through the signed Kaji call; final applicable CI
escalation: A change to what crosses the Kaji line goes to a fresh-context design review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13 in the full audit: one filter in the peer handler plus a regression. Not a measurement.
